record: D755 (step 1: the sourced ECB calendar, committed before the runner's run)
contents: dates and clock times only (and the decision's direction); no price, no surprise measure, no expectation

sources.per_row: source_url: that meeting's 'Monetary policy decisions' press release, fetched 2026-10-02. Its date, its decision and its sentence 'press conference starting at X CET today' (written '2.30 p.m.' up to 2015-03-05, '14.30'/'14:30'/'14:45' after) are the row's date, decision and press_conference_start_cet.

decision_release_time.how: NOT stated on any per-meeting page. It is the ECB's published schedule: 13:45 CET up to 2022-06-09 and 14:15 CET from 2022-07-21.
decision_release_time.source: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/pr/date/2022/html/ecb.pr220627~73acedf868.en.html (27 June 2022, 'New times for ECB's monetary policy decisions and press conference': from 21 July decisions are published at 14:15 CET instead of 13:45, press conferences begin at 14:45 CET instead of 14:30)
decision_release_time.corroboration: a contemporaneous report of the 2011-12-08 cut published 12:50 GMT (13:50 CET) that day, before the 13:30 GMT press conference: https://investinglive.com/news/!/ecb-cuts-refi-rate-to-1-00-surprising-some-20111208/
decision_release_time.note: Applying 13:45 to every meeting before 2022-07-21 is the one inference in the file; it is disclosed in every row's time_source.

decision_coding.rule: hike / cut / no change on the main refinancing rate, except where only the deposit rate moved

flagged.2015-12-03: main refinancing rate unchanged at 0.05%; deposit rate cut to -0.30%; coded cut
flagged.2019-09-12: main refinancing rate unchanged at 0.00%; deposit rate cut to -0.50%; coded cut

excluded.2020-03-18: PEPP announcement: an evening press release with no press conference; not in the monetary policy decisions list
excluded.2014-10-26: the comprehensive-assessment press conference, not a monetary policy meeting
excluded.2021-07-08: the strategy-review press conference; no monetary policy decisions release (2021-07-22 is the meeting)

verification.compiler: a Sonnet agent fetched all 120 press releases (WebFetch, verbatim quotes requested)
verification.second_pass: independent re-fetch on 2026-10-02 of 6 rows (seeded random sample, seed 755: 2011-09-08, 2014-03-06, 2014-07-03, 2015-06-03, 2017-04-27, 2022-12-15) and of the 2022-06-27 timing release: date, press-conference time and decision all match; the per-year date list and the 22 rate changes match the known 2011-2023 ECB record
